id: \bClay will be tough. You can do it.
en: \bClay will be tough. You can do it.

id: \bGo fight Clay. Or don't. I don't care.
en: \bGo fight Clay. Or don't. I don't care.
it: \bVai a sfidare Rafan. Oppure no. Non mi interessa.

id: \bClay uses Ground type Pokémon. They are weak against Grass, Water, and Ice types.
en: \bClay uses Ground type Pokémon. They are weak against Grass, Water, and Ice types.
it: \bRafan usa Pokémon di tipo Terra. Sono deboli contro i tipi Erba, Acqua e Ghiaccio.

id: \bThey are strong against Electric, Fire, Poison, Rock, and Steel. Poison and Rock also don't do much damage. They are immune to Electric types.
en: \bThey are strong against Electric, Fire, Poison, Rock, and Steel. Poison and Rock also don't do much damage. They are immune to Electric types.
it: \bSono forti contro i tipi Elettro, Fuoco, Veleno, Roccia e Acciaio. Anche Veleno e Roccia non fanno molti danni. E sono immuni al tipo Elettro.
\bChe ne dici di divertirci un po'?

id: \bClay: I heard you helped out at the island. While I appreciate it, it isn't gonna make me go easy on ya.
en: \bClay: I heard you helped out at the island. While I appreciate it, it isn't gonna make me go easy on ya.
it: \bRafan: Ho saputo che hai dato una mano sull'isola. Lo apprezzo, ma non per questo ci andrò piano con te.
\bRafan: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Sisma.

id: \bTM28 contains Dig. A two-turned attack that deals powerful damage.
en: \bTM28 contains Dig. A two-turned attack that deals powerful damage.
it: \bLa MT28 contiene Fossa. Un attacco in due turni che infligge danni ingenti.

id: \bClay: You beating me was a fluke. Don't think that it would happen again.
en: \bClay: You beating me was a fluke. Don't think that it would happen again.
it: \bRafan: Che tu mi abbia battuto è stato un colpo di fortuna. Non pensare che succederà di nuovo.
